Battlefield is an upcoming American military action film written, co-produced, and directed by Christopher McQuarrie. It is based on the video game series by Electronic Arts.
Production
In April 2026, it was announced that Christopher McQuarrie would be writing and directing a live-action adaptation of the video games series Battlefield, with Michael B. Jordan co-producing and potentially starring. McQuarrie pitched to several studios including Apple Original Films and Sony Pictures Releasing on April 23, 2026, as well as meeting with other studios the next day. Later that month, Warner Bros. Pictures, Universal Pictures, Amazon MGM Studios, and Netflix joined the bidding war.
